item.title: LVMH’s Belmond Upgrades Its Hotels While Rivals Chase Scale
item.description: Belmond is renovating its classic luxury hotels rather than playing the game of scaling up fast.

item.title: International Travel to the U.S. Has Dropped for 7 Straight Months
item.description: A full recovery in inbound tourism isn't expected until 2029, and new fees and vetting requirements won't help.

item.title: The Climate Claims Airlines Can No Longer Talk About in Europe
item.description: The EU's crackdown exposes how widespread aviation green claims have become.

item.title: An Existential Threat? Booking Exec Sees AI as an Expansion Opportunity
item.description: Booking's CFO thinks artificial intelligence can put his company on the offensive rather than the defensive. The odds are long but based on past performance you can't count them out.

item.title: How to Use Skift Megatrends 2026: A Playbook for Travel Operators
item.description: The next 12–24 months will reward operators who act on trends early, not those who wait for certainty.

item.title: How AI-First Thinking Is Reshaping Airline Innovation
item.description: Travel brands are racing to adopt AI, but real progress comes from rebuilding foundations rather than layering tech onto legacy systems. Airlines that take an AI-first approach can operate proactively, personalize at scale, and deliver smoother experiences.

item.title: It’s Not Just Social Media. Here’s All the Data the U.S. Wants from Travelers
item.description: Extreme vetting, along with more travel fees, could deter tourists ahead of major events like the World Cup.

item.title: Why Culture Is Becoming Abu Dhabi’s Most Valuable Tourism Asset
item.description: The global appetite for authentic travel is increasingly central to demand, and the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi is meeting it with scale and intention. Its cultural strategy shows a destination treating curiosity as its most valuable currency.

item.title: The Ugly New Math Crushing Hotels
item.description: The math is bad. Rising wages, taxes, insurance premiums, and other costs are outrunning revenue growth at many hotels.

item.title: Google Turns Millions of Earbuds Into Live Translators
item.description: Google’s new beta feature turns nearly any earbuds paired with Android phones into live AI translators. That makes language more accessible — and less of a friction point for travel.
